faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 made in China?
faqs.a: The Philips-authored technical sheet revision 03, dated 28 April 2025, identifies China as the Oxygenate 5 production country and Jiangsu Konsung as manufacturer, with model code KSW-5. Check the label and documents for the individual India-sold unit.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 a Konsung KSW-5?
faqs.a: Oxygenate 5 documentation identifies manufacturer model KSW-5, Konsung manufacture and Philips distribution. The manual uses KSW-5 (Oxygenate 5). This does not prove identical components, accessories or warranty across every version or market.

faqs.q: How much does Oxygenate 5 cost in India?
faqs.a: HHZ displays ₹45,000–₹55,000 as a budgeting estimate, not a verified market range. One retailer listing showed ₹45,000 when checked on 3 November 2026. The upper budget is not a verified seller quote. Confirm the exact configuration, taxes, availability, delivery and accessories.
faqs.sourceLabel: Single retailer listing checked on 3 November 2026

faqs.q: What warranty is advertised in India?
faqs.a: Philips India describes a three-year limited device warranty and a 10,000-hour sieve warranty. Ask for the applicable written conditions, exclusions and claim process.
faqs.sourceLabel: Philips India launch and warranty announcement

faqs.q: What are the Philips Oxygenate 5 specifications?
faqs.a: Philips India publishes 0.5–5 L/min continuous flow, 93% ±3% oxygen concentration, 18 kg weight, sound below 40 dB(A) under specified conditions, and 230 V / 50 Hz input. The electrical rating is below 360 VA, not a measured wattage.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 the same as Philips EverFlo?
faqs.a: Philips Oxygenate 5 and Philips EverFlo are separate product families. Oxygenate 5 documents identify the Konsung-manufactured KSW-5; that does not establish parts, accessories or warranty compatibility with EverFlo. Compare exact model documents and regional versions.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 worth the price?
faqs.a: HHZ would not pay extra for the Philips logo alone. Assess the exact Oxygenate 5 package, prescribed requirements, applicable warranty and usable service. The ₹45,000–₹55,000 figure is an HHZ budgeting estimate; a historical premium over Konsung KSW-5 has not been verified. Any higher quote should have concrete value beyond the badge.

faqs.q: What does Philips branding add to Oxygenate 5?
faqs.a: Philips branding and distribution are documented. Philips India advertises a three-year limited warranty, a 10,000-hour sieve warranty and additional filters. Confirm the terms and service for the actual unit; the badge alone does not prove superior engineering or performance.
faqs.sourceLabel: Philips India launch and warranty announcement

faqs.q: Does Chinese manufacture mean Oxygenate 5 is poor quality?
faqs.a: No. Chinese manufacture by itself does not establish poor quality. Judge model-specific evidence, warranty, service and total price. HHZ has not bench-tested this unit or established superiority or inferiority against another KSW-5 configuration.

Philips publishes nominal weights of 18 kg for Oxygenate 5 and 14 kg for EverFlo. The difference is 4 kg, approximately 28.6% relative to EverFlo. These are published figures, not HHZ measurements of matched units. Assess handling before purchase. Total weight does not identify sieve chemistry.

faqs.q: What should I check about Oxygenate 5 service near me?
faqs.a: The manual directs owners to Philips Respironics for service facilitation. Obtain the responsible local provider, repair/shipment arrangements, approved-parts availability, turnaround and itemised charges in writing. HHZ has not audited city-level service or parts stocks.

faqs.q: Why does the Oxygenate 5 brochure exclude US sale?
faqs.a: Philips brochure MCI 4112765 v00, dated May 2025, says the product was unavailable for US sale in that document. The brochure does not explain why or establish current US availability. The statement does not by itself prove an FDA ban or failed testing.
